crbirding

crbirding is an R package to prepare colour-ringing data from (CR-Birding) for publication in a research repository. With crbirding you can transform CR-Birding data to Darwin Core for publication to the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS).

To get started, see the function reference.

Installation

You can install the development version of crbirding from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("inbo/crbirding")
